chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan said: All of these reports indicate that it is appropriate for him to wash her from over the clothes. As for the woman, then what is more appropriate likewise is that she wash the man from over the clothes. That which indicates this is what he narrated:

key_terms.الثِّيَابِ: the clothes over which the washing is to be performed
key_terms.الْأَخْبَارُ: the transmitted reports used as evidence
key_terms.الْأَوْلَى: that which is preferable or more appropriate
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةُ: the woman discussed in the legal ruling
key_terms.رَوَاهُ: he narrated it, introducing supporting transmission
key_terms.يَنْبَغِي: it is appropriate or fitting in legal practice
key_terms.يُغَسِّلَهَا: he washes her body for funerary rites

ai.seo_question: What do the reports in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām indicate about washing the deceased of the opposite sex from over clothing?
ai.summary: This passage presents a juristic conclusion drawn by Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan from earlier reports regarding washing the deceased. It states that the more appropriate practice is for a man or woman to wash the opposite sex from over the clothing, and it introduces a supporting narration for that ruling.
